evidence_items.finding: owner cannot meet payroll this week despite reporting steady monthly revenue of $52K for eight months
evidence_items.rationale: Payroll shortfall in the presence of reported steady revenue is a critical adverse working capital signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: owner estimates outstanding invoices at approximately $40,000 but has no formal tracking system
evidence_items.rationale: Unverified estimate of outstanding invoices with no formal AR system is a critical adverse visibility signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: invoicing is done via Word PDF emails with no accounts receivable follow-up schedule
evidence_items.rationale: Manual ad hoc invoicing without a collection process is a critical adverse process maturity signal. process_maturity; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: owner has drawn on personal savings twice in the past four months to cover shortfalls
evidence_items.rationale: Repeated personal savings drawdowns is a critical adverse liquidity signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: cleaning services; $52K monthly revenue; $3,200 cash today; $18,400 payroll due Friday; no AR system; Word invoicing; personal savings borrowed twice in 4 months
Surface signal (not root cause): revenue has been steady at $52K per month for eight months suggesting no revenue problem
evidence_items.rationale: Steady revenue is a misleading signal when cash is insufficient for payroll — the issue is likely timing between invoice issue and receipt.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): a large invoice of approximately $22,000 is expected to clear this week
evidence_items.rationale: Expected invoice clearance is a misleading one-off relief signal — it does not address the structural collection process gap that created the shortfall.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Estimated $40K outstanding on $52K monthly revenue implies approximately 30-45 days average outstanding; value_override 45 days as conservative proxy

validation_notes: SIM-13-001 is SUPPORTED via working_capital_stress. Missing AR data: sidecar cannot resolve collection lag without bank statements. No must_identify vocabulary.
